name: AndroidDebugBridge
description: Control AndroidTV/FireTV devices through ADB from the Home Assistant Core docker image. See here: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/androidtv/

variables.name: Boot Wait Time
variables.description: Length of time in seconds to wait after the container has started before attempting to connect to devices.

variables.name: Device List
variables.description: Comma separated list of androidtv/firetv devices to connect to, each one listed as :[port], :[port].

variables.name: Check Frequency
variables.description: Length of time in seconds to wait between successive attempts to connect (or re-connect) to devices.
